thread:
anya: Kicking off a Citrine Tech POC today. They need SSO (SAML + OIDC), SCIM provisioning, and RBAC scoped by org unit. Also strict domain controls. Can we confirm ops checklist?

mike: Thanks — quick Q: are they targeting Redwood Hosted or Dedicated for the POC?

anya: Hosted for POC. If things go well they'll request Dedicated later.

raj: Noted. For Hosted POC we need:
- test IdP (SAML metadata + entityID)
- SCIM write endpoint with token (we can use a staging token)
- RBAC mapping doc (SCIM groups -> roles)

sarah: Also ask security for required pen-test reports / SOC docs. @elaine can you confirm what packaging we can provide for commercial customers? :eyes: 

elaine: I can provide SOC2 summary + encryption posture doc. For Citrine we should also surface KMS integration options (bring-your-own KMS for Dedicated later).

presales-bot: Automated checklist created: POC-1739999991. Items: idp-setup, scim-sandbox, rbac-mapping, security-docs, pricing-ask.

mike: On pricing: POC is free for 30 days but note that if they require private logs retention or extra observability we may bill add-ons. Sarah, can you draft a one-pager for sales?

sarah: Yup. I'll include: expected token costs, XPU hours estimate, add-on observability costs, and Dedicated uplift. Will post draft in ~2h.

anya: Citrine's legal sent a security questionnaire (20 pages). Key asks: data residency, data deletion, SCIM delta retention, domain control proof flow. Anyone seen this exact form before?

raj: We handled a near-identical questionnaire for Meridian. Answers we gave: Hosted data stored in region X, deletion API within 30 days, SCIM deltas retained 7 days for retry. Domain control: TXT proof or upload a verification file. I can paste our response bundle.

anya: Please paste, that would help. Also they want SCIM rate limits and backoff strategy.

raj: Pasting snippets:
```
SCIM rate limits: 100 req/min per tenant. Retry/backoff: 429 includes Retry-After header. Exponential backoff recommended (1s, 2s, 4s).
SCIM example config:
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "userName": "jdoe@citrine.com" }
```

elaine: Good. Legal will also ask about domain ownership for SSO (we verify with a TXT or file). If they need delegated domain proofs across subdomains we can accept org-level TXT records.

mike: Ops detail: For Hosted POC we can set a tenant-scoped SCIM token and short TTL. For Dedicated we'll discuss scoped API keys + network peering.

anya: Can someone own the security questionnaire answers and the upload? I'll coordinate with Citrine tomorrow.

sarah: I can own the questionnaire upload. Send me the Meridian bundle and any outstanding bits.

raj: Sending bundle now. Also note: if Citrine requires JIT provisioning vs full sync, we should clarify which SCIM workflows they want — JIT reduces provisioning load.

anya: Good point. I'll ask them to pick sync vs JIT.

presales-bot: Reminder: schedule POC kickoff call — use calendar link: https://cal.redwood.io/poc/1739999991

anya: Thanks all. Next steps: Sarah will draft pricing one-pager; Raj will paste full Meridian responses; Elaine will attach SOC/KMS docs; I'll schedule kickoff and confirm JIT vs sync. Will update thread with links. :thumbsup:
